neighbours.label: A new leader's first moves or change agenda after taking charge (vowed to transform, the first thing he did, turnaround, quickly replaced)
fire: Shortly after her appointment, the new chief executive promised to overhaul the struggling airline.
One of the first things the incoming mayor did was to cancel the stadium deal.
The board hired a veteran manager to engineer a turnaround at the ailing chain.
Within weeks of taking power, the new prime minister replaced the head of the central bank.
The coach, appointed in May, vowed to rebuild the losing team from the ground up.
On his first day in office, the governor scrapped his predecessor's tax plan.
The new principal set out to reform the failing school within two years.
After the takeover, the new owners quickly sold off the unprofitable divisions.
quiet: Years after her appointment, the chief executive still eats lunch in the airline canteen.
The mayor attended the opening of the new library on Sunday.
The veteran manager has worked at the chain for thirty years.
The prime minister met the head of the central bank at a dinner.
The coach, a former player, enjoys fishing in the summer.
The governor lives with his family in a house near the capital.
The principal greeted parents at the school gate each morning.
The owners of the company live in a quiet town by the sea.
